service_name.description: Service name for the init script (typically matches the package/service name).

project_name.description: Project name used for paths, users, and group names.

uwsgi_ini_app.description: Path to the uWSGI application executable (script or binary).

uwsgi_threads.description: Number of threads per uWSGI worker.

uwsgi_listen.description: Number of sockets in the queue (listen backlog).

uwsgi_port.description: Port on which uWSGI will bind for HTTP(S) communication.
